The truly impressive element is their use of looped audio to build every number, with the performers playing several instruments and singing live into microphones.
Our collective voice becomes the material for a musical loop, and we are integrated into the final song.
The harmony of the interwoven stories, of life, of music and song, had us clapping and cheering and dancing in our seats.
Once the musical architecture locks into place, “the story and the storytelling take over and make Mexodus fly.”
It's a wild woosh of energy, designed to disorient, overturn, and enlighten.
The latest show offered by Audible Theater is more than a play or a musical but might be categorized as an impactful theatrical event.
